arxiv-1708-06828.title: Classification of Radiology Reports Using Neural Attention Models
arxiv-1708-06828.creator: Bonggun Shin 1 , Falgun H. Chokshi 2, 3 , Timothy Lee 1 , Jinho D. Choi 1
arxiv-1708-06828.description: Abstract The electronic health record (EHR) contains a large amount of multi-dimensional and unstructured clinical data of significant operational and research value. Distinguished from previous studies, our approach embraces a double-annotated dataset and strays away from obscure “black-box” models to comprehensive deep learning models.

arxiv-2206-13055.title: Decentralized Identifier-based Privacy-preserving Authenticated Key Exchange Protocol for Electric Vehicle Charging in Smart Grid
arxiv-2206-13055.creator: Rohini Poolat Parameswarath, Prosanta Gope, Senior Member, IEEE, Biplab Sikdar, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2206-13055.description: Abstract The popularity of Electric Vehicles (EVs) has been rising across the globe in recent years. Smart grids will be the backbone for EV charging and enable efficient consumption of electricity by the EVs. With the demand for EVs, associated cyber threats are also increasing. Users expose their personal information while charging their EVs, leading to privacy threats.

arxiv-2306-08322.title: Cryptography approach for Secure Outsourced Data Storage in Cloud Environment
arxiv-2306-08322.creator: Rishabh Gupta, Deepika Saxena, Ashutosh Kumar Singh
arxiv-2306-08322.description: Abstract A large amount of data and applications are migrated by researchers, stakeholders, academia, and business organizations to the cloud environment due to its large variety of services, which involve the least maintenance cost, maximum flexibility, and on-demand service for storage, computation, and data distribution intentions. Despite the various characteristics the cloud environment supports, it also faces many challenges.

arxiv-2401-00928.title: OSINT Research Studios: A Flexible Crowdsourcing Framework to Scale Up Open Source Intelligence Investigations DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work & Social Computing; November 9–13, 2024; San José, Costa Rica Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 C
arxiv-2401-00928.creator: Anirban Mukhopadhyay, Sukrit Venkatagiri, Kurt Luther
arxiv-2401-00928.description: Abstract . Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) investigations, which rely entirely on publicly available data such as social media, play an increasingly important role in solving crimes and holding governments accountable. The growing volume of data and complex nature of tasks, however, means there is a pressing need to scale and speed up OSINT investigations.

arxiv-2406-05450.title: Well-balanced high order finite difference WENO schemes for a first-order Z4 formulation of the Einstein field equations
arxiv-2406-05450.creator: Dinshaw Balsara, Deepak Bhoriya, Olindo Zanotti, Michael Dumbser
arxiv-2406-05450.description: Abstract We develop a new class of high–order accurate well-balanced finite difference (FD) Weighted Essentially Non-Oscillatory (WENO) methods for numerical general relativity, which can be applied to any first–order reduction of the Einstein field equations, even if non–conservative terms are present.

arxiv-2511-16903.title: Simple Circuit Extensions for XOR in PTIME
arxiv-2511-16903.creator: Marco Carmosino, Ngu Dang, Tim Jackman
arxiv-2511-16903.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marco Carmosino, Ngu Dang, Tim Jackman. The Minimum Circuit Size Problem for Partial Functions ( 𝖬𝖢𝖲𝖯 ∗ {\mathsf{MCSP}}^{*} ) is hard assuming the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH) (Ilango, 2020). This breakthrough hardness result leveraged a characterization of the optimal { ∧ , ∨ , ¬ } \{\land,\lor,\neg\} circuits for n n -bit 𝖮𝖱 {\mathsf{OR}} ( 𝖮𝖱 n {\mathsf{OR}}_{n} ) and a reduction from the partial f f -Simple Extension Problem where f = 𝖮𝖱 n f={\mathsf{OR}}_{n} .

pmc-10611943.title: The Uses of Photodynamic Therapy Versus Anti-vascular Endothelial Growth Factor in the Management of Acute Central Serous Chorioretinopathy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-10611943.creator: Hadeel Seraj, Mustafa Alhamoud, Mohammed S Khoshhal, Hassan Alhashim, Anas Alsaif, Amro Abukhashabah
pmc-10611943.description: Central serous chorioretinopathy (CSCR) is an idiopathic chorioretinal disease characterized by localized serous detachment of the neurosensory retina at the macula. To date, there is no high-quality evidence of recent updates on treating acute CSCR, focusing on photodynamic therapy (PDT) and anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF).

pmc-10648358.title: A real-world case–control study on the efficacy and safety of pulsed field ablation for atrial fibrillation
pmc-10648358.creator: Ming Yang, Peng-yu Wang, Ying-lu Hao, Mei Liang, Zi-yang Yu, Xi-chen Li, Yan-ping Li
pmc-10648358.description: ObjectiveThe primary objective of this study was to evaluate the efficacy and safety of pulsed field ablation in individuals diagnosed with atrial fibrillation.MethodsA total of 36 patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation were enrolled in the pulsed field ablation group, while another 36 patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation were included in the radiofrequency ablation group.

pmc-10739586.title: Hyaluronic Acid Hydrogels with Phototunable Supramolecular Cross-Linking for Spatially Controlled Lymphatic Tube Formation
pmc-10739586.creator: Fei Fan, Bo Su, Alexander Kolodychak, Ephraim Ekwueme, Laura Alderfer, Sanjoy Saha, Matthew J. Webber, Donny Hanjaya-Putra
pmc-10739586.description: The dynamics of the extracellular matrix (ECM) influences stem cell differentiation and morphogenesis into complex lymphatic networks. While dynamic hydrogels with stress relaxation properties have been developed, many require detailed chemical processing to tune viscoelasticity, offering a limited opportunity for in situ and spatiotemporal control.

pmc-11287857.title: Single-cell hdWGCNA reveals metastatic protective macrophages and development of deep learning model in uveal melanoma
pmc-11287857.creator: Yifang Sun, Jian Wu, Qian Zhang, Pengzhen Wang, Jinglin Zhang, Yonggang Yuan
pmc-11287857.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAlthough there has been some progress in the treatment of primary uveal melanoma (UVM), distant metastasis remains the leading cause of death in patients. Monitoring, staging, and treatment of metastatic disease have not yet reached consensus. Although more than half of metastatic tumors (62%) are diagnosed within five years after primary tumor treatment, the remainder are only detected in the following 25 years.

pmc-11359743.title: Enhancing physical and cognitive function in older adults through walking & resistance exercise: Korean national aging project randomized controlled study
pmc-11359743.creator: Parivash Jamrasi, Xinxing Li, Yunho Sung, Dong Hyun Kim, Seo Hyun Ahn, Yu Seon Kang, Wook Song
pmc-11359743.description: BackgroundThe rapid aging of Korea's population underscores the urgent need for effective programs to enhance the well-being and longevity of the elderly. This study presents preliminary results from the Korean project, examining the impact of cost-effective and accessible exercise programs on functional performance of older people and to determine the long-term maintenance of intervention.

pmc-11401325.title: Correction: Common subclinical hypothyroidism during Whipple’s disease
pmc-11401325.creator: Jean-Christophe Lagier, Florence Fenollar, Jacques Chiaroni, Christophe Picard, Christiane Oddoze, Laurent Abi-Rached, Didier Raoult
pmc-11401325.description: was obtained from all the participating patients in the study. The study was conducted as part of normal care, without supplementary patient’s samples. The study was approved by the Ethics Committee of the Institut Fédératif de Recherche IFR48, Faculty of Medicine, Marseille France (agreement number 13-028-02). pmc-11431090.title: Overcoming Limited Access to Virus Infection Rapid Testing: Development of a Lateral Flow Test for SARS-CoV-2 with Locally Available Resources
pmc-11431090.creator: Estefanía S Peri Ibáñez, Agostina Mazzeo, Carolina Silva, Maria Juliana Juncos, Guadalupe S Costa Navarro, Horacio M Pallarés, Virginia J Wolos, Gabriel L Fiszman, Silvia L Mundo, Julio J Caramelo, Marcelo J Yanovsky, Matías Fingermann, Alejandro A Castello, Andrea V Gamarnik, Ana S Peinetti, Daiana
pmc-11431090.description: The COVID-19 pandemic highlighted testing inequities in developing countries. Lack of lateral flow test (LFT) manufacturing capacity was a major COVID-19 response bottleneck in low- and middle-income regions. Here we report the development of an open-access LFT for SARS-CoV-2 detection comparable to commercial tests that requires only locally available supplies.

pmc-11515785.title: The psychometric properties of Chinese version of the Gilles de la Tourette syndrome-quality of life scale (GTS-QOL) for children and adolescents
pmc-11515785.creator: Kai Yang, Xianbin Wang, Shujin Hu, Yanlin Li, Tianyuan Lei, Ying Li, Yonghua Cui
pmc-11515785.description: BackgroundGilles de la Tourette syndrome (GTS) is a persistent neurological disorder that profoundly affects the quality of life for afflicted individuals, however, tailored health-related quality of life (QOL) measures for Chinese pediatric GTS patients are lacking. This pioneering study aims to develop a QOL scale for Chinese children with GTS.

pmc-11622863.title: Application of big data and artificial intelligence in visual communication art design
pmc-11622863.creator: Ailing Zhang
pmc-11622863.description: In the era of continuous development of computer technology, the application of artificial intelligence (AI) and big data is becoming more and more extensive. With the help of powerful computer and network technology, the art of visual communication (VISCOM) has ushered in a new chapter of digitalization and intelligence.

pmc-11662948.title: Detection of serum FOXM1 and IGF2 in patients with ARDS and their correlation with disease and prognosis
pmc-11662948.creator: Chao Liu, Shengrui Zhang, Weiwei Zhang, Jinfeng Wang
pmc-11662948.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). pmc-12368223.title: Expression profiles of miR-411 and SPRY4 as indicators of disease progression and treatment in chronic myelogenous leukemia
pmc-12368223.creator: Ashkan Shabannezhad, Nasrin Alizadghandforoush, Majid Safa, Shahrbano Rostami, Bahram Chahardouli, Ali Amini
pmc-12368223.description: Chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) is a clonal neoplasm originating from hematopoietic stem cells which is characterized by t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) fusion gene leading to forming an oncoprotein. miR-411 and SPRY4 may influence CML leukemogenesis by regulating proliferation, differentiation, and various signaling pathways induced by the oncoprotein.

pmc-12707444.title: The influence of periodontal disease and periodontal treatment on colorectal cancer
pmc-12707444.creator: Ursa Potocnik Rebersak, Erik Brecelj, Rok Schara
pmc-12707444.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPeriodontal disease (PD) is associated with more than 50 diseases and conditions, including colorectal cancer. The study aimed to investigate if periodontal treatment influences the blood levels of C-reactive protein (CRP) in colorectal cancer patients.

pmc-13053661.title: Genetic Susceptibility to Rheumatic Heart Disease: A Narrative Literature Review Highlighting Evidence From African Populations and Research Gaps in Sudan
pmc-13053661.creator: Hussam Alkhalifamohamed, Waleed M A Jebreel, Mohamed Elhassan, Sulafa K M Ali
pmc-13053661.description: Background and AimsRheumatic heart disease (RHD) remains a significant public health burden in low‐ and middle‐income countries, particularly in sub‐Saharan Africa. Although socioeconomic factors contribute to disease persistence, genetic susceptibility plays a critical role in determining progression from Group A Streptococcal infection to acute rheumatic fever (ARF) and chronic RHD.

pmc-13122208.title: Off-label and repurposed use of disulfiram beyond alcohol dependence: A systematic review of clinical and preclinical evidence
pmc-13122208.creator: Beáta-Mária Benkő, Neuza Sofia De Brito Parreirinha, István Sebe, Romána Zelkó
pmc-13122208.description: SummaryThis systematic review assesses off-label and repurposed uses of disulfiram (DIS) beyond alcohol dependence, synthesizing clinical trials, case reports, and preclinical studies (2015–2025) per PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Database and registry searches yielded 229 studies: 44 clinical trials (mainly cancer, infectious diseases) and 185 articles. Cancer-led indications, followed by infectious, inflammatory, cognitive, and metabolic diseases.

pmc-13284627.title: Continued Nintedanib Treatment in Children and Adolescents With Fibrosing ILDs: Data From InPedILD‐ON
pmc-13284627.creator: Robin Deterding, Lisa R Young, Emily M DeBoer, David Warburton, Steven Cunningham, Nicolaus Schwerk, Kevin K Brown, Václav Koucký, Jason P Weinman, Jill Simmons, Mihaela Dumistracel, Frauke Jantzen, Martina Gahlemann, Matthias Griese, the InPedILD‐ON trial investigators
pmc-13284627.description: BackgroundIn the InPedILD trial, nintedanib had an acceptable safety profile in children and adolescents (aged 6−17 years) with fibrosing ILDs. The open‐label extension of the InPedILD trial, InPedILD‐ON, is assessing the longer‐term safety of nintedanib in these patients.MethodsPatients who completed the InPedILD trial on treatment and had a transition period of ≤12 weeks entered InPedILD‐ON as “rollover patients.

pmc-13437582.title: Aripiprazole modulates splenic microbiota and immune response elicited by single prolonged stress in rats
pmc-13437582.creator: Peter Vargovic, Andrej Tillinger, Lubica Horvathova, Lila Dziewiczova, Jana Osacka
pmc-13437582.description: BackgroundPost-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is associated with dysregulation of the hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal (HPA) axis and the sympatho-adrenomedullary system, leading to immune imbalance and alterations in microbiota composition. Stress-induced disruption of intestinal barrier integrity may promote bacterial translocation to peripheral organs, including the spleen. Aripiprazole (ARI), an atypical antipsychotic proposed for PTSD treatment, also modulates the immune system and microbiota.

pmc-13455164.title: Fecal microbiota transplantation from Hezuo pigs alleviates intestinal inflammatory injury in Clostridium perfringens type C-infected piglets via modulation gut microbiota and intestinal barrier
pmc-13455164.creator: Qiaoli Yang, YuHao Liang, Jing Liu, Rui Jia, Jie Li, ZunQiang Yan
pmc-13455164.description: Clostridium perfringens type C (CpC)-induced piglet diarrhea is a major challenge in the swine industry. This study aimed to investigate the protective effects of fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) from Hezuo pigs against intestinal injury in Duroc×Landrace×Yorkshire (DLY) suckling piglets infected with CpC.

pmc-13556449.title: 726. Invasive neuromodulation for improved outcomes in patients with severe forms of OCD and depression
pmc-13556449.creator: C Kraus, V Watzal, N Grüll, A Gramser, K Novak
pmc-13556449.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). uslaw-usc-t18-s664.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s664.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 31 (Embezzlement And Theft). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any person who embezzles, steals, or unlawfully and willfully abstracts or converts to his own use or to the use of another, any of the moneys, funds, securities, premiums, credits, property, or other assets of any employee welfare benefit plan.
